Captain Morgan is a premium spirit brand made with the finest Caribbean rums. Captain Morgan
Gold was launched in 2017, targeting 18-to 24-year-old consumers in Kenya, anchored on Captain
Morgan Original Spiced, which was launched in 1982 for the global market. The brand exists to
inspire everyone to add their own flavour of fun.
In FY2023/24, Captain Morgan launched its first-ever pan-African campaign, “Spice On” in Kenya. The
new platform sought to captivate adventure-seekers who yearn to authentically express themselves
and unleash their own unique flavours. As an unapologetic, authentic, and accessible champion of
fun, Captain Morgan invites consumers to unlock their full potential by bringing something original,
distinctive, and enjoyable to the mix.
The brand leveraged the launch to unveil a brand-new pack design which is refreshed to match
our new brand identity. With this new chapter we are looking to give our consumers unique brand
experiences while maintaining the integrity of the liquid. The new Captain Morgan pack design
highlights the quality, flavour, and spice of the liquid, with a refreshed version of the iconic Captain
symbol to maintain recognisability.
To add flavour to the spice in the year the brand also onboarded “Mejja” a Kenyan genge artist
as the lead brand influencer. He enjoys a massive following by Kenyan youths as he embodies
the character of fun. The positive consumer feedback on the campaign, influencer and the new
look pack have seen the brand accelerate its performance growing double digits compared to the
previous year. The brand has also increased awareness, trial, and penetration month on month to
solidify commercialisation of the brand. #SpiceOn
